source.description:
Selfie in Denim Jacket

A blond-haired young man stands on a quiet street, holding his chin in a thoughtful pose for a close-up selfie. He wears a distressed denim jacket with red stitching details and a torn patch on the shoulder. A faint red mark is visible on the back of his hand as he pouts slightly at the camera.

Parked cars line the road behind him, and a scooter rests near a shuttered storefront, indicating an urban neighborhood setting. The casual, candid shot captures a moment of playful self-expression and street-style fashion.
